title: Local derived residue comparison for a specified completed perfect model
statement:
Let $X,S$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $i:S\hookrightarrow X$ a locally closed immersion, $A$ a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and $I\subset A$ a maximal ideal such that $A$ is $I$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Let $K$ be in the derived category of modules over the completed constant $A$-ring on $X$, let $U$ be an object of $S_{\mathrm{proet}}$, and let $P$ be a bounded cochain complex of finitely generated projective $A$-modules [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. Assume an isomorphism between the local restrictions to $U$ of $K$ and $\operatorname{sfbCompletedModel}(X,I,P)$, with exactly the constructions of [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data] and localized sites of [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Put $k=A/I$ and $L=(-)|_U\circ i^{-1}$ in fixed $k$-scalars. There is an isomorphism in the unbounded derived category
$$L\bigl(Q(\operatorname{sfbResidueComplex}(X,I,K))\bigr)\simeq Q\bigl((k\otimes_A P)_{S_{\mathrm{proet}}/U}\bigr),$$
where the right side is the termwise constant sheaf of the ordinary algebraic residue complex used in [lem-sfb-adic-perfect-model-complete-reduction]. There is no global stratification, finiteness-of-homology or etale-origin conclusion.

proof.text: Apply proEtaleLocalScalarDerivedIso to the local isomorphism e, the actual completed ring and its first finite projection. This identifies the local fixed-scalar derived residues of K and sfbCompletedModel X I P. No normalization of the completed inverse-image ring is needed in the model calculation.

The bounded-above completed constant realization of P is K-flat: projectivity gives flatness of the constant realization and its scalar extension, and the independent-universe bounded-flat criterion applies. Therefore its derived residue is ordinary scalar extension. Scalar-extension adjunctions and pbcRestrictComp identify successive scalar extensions with extension along their composite. CompletedConstantReduction.base_exists identifies this composite with the constant quotient map. ConstantScalarRealization.complexComparison is invertible termwise and identifies the result with the commutative constant realization of algebraicResidue I P.

Identify sfbFixedScalarRestriction with the existing normalized constant-ring restriction by the identity on additive sections and restriction_smul. Its composite with commutative constant realization is the fixed-scalar constant sheaf functor. Exact restriction and the localization representative isomorphisms give the global derived residue calculation. Apply the exact fixed-scalar inverse image and slice restriction. Their constant-sheaf comparisons identify the result with the constant algebraic residue complex on the slice, and compose with step 1.

proof_origin.place: Proposition 6.6.11 reverse implication; G6 calculates the global model directly by bounded-flat K-flatness, scalar-extension associativity and constant scalar normalization, then applies fixed-scalar restriction. Only the generic locality step is split off.

lean.statement:
theorem adicResidue_localModelComparison
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (i : S ⟶ X) [IsImmersion i]
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.IsMaximal) [IsAdicComplete I A]
    (K : DerivedCategory.{u + 2, u + 1, u + 2} (proEtaleRingModules X (adicLisseCompletedRing X I)))
    (U : S.ProEt) (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1, u + 1} A) ℤ) (a b : ℤ)
    (hbounded : ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero (P.X q))
    (hP : ∀ q : ℤ, Module.Finite A (P.X q) ∧ Module.Projective A (P.X q))
    (e : Nonempty (sfbLocalRestriction.{u} i (adicLisseCompletedRing X I) U K ≅
      sfbLocalRestriction.{u} i (adicLisseCompletedRing X I) U (sfbCompletedModel.{u} X I P)))
    :
    let L := ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1, u + 1} (A ⧸ I ^ (0 + 1))) i ⋙
      (ProEt.topology S).overPullback (ModuleCat.{u + 1, u + 1} (A ⧸ I ^ (0 + 1))) U
    letI : L.Additive := Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products L
    let C := constantSheaf ((ProEt.topology S).over U)
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1, u + 1} (A ⧸ I ^ (0 + 1)))
    letI : C.Additive := Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products C
    Nonempty (L.mapDerivedCategory.obj
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (sfbResidueComplex.{u} X I K)) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        ((C.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (AdicPerfectModel.algebraicResidue I P)))
